bounded_host_request.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
umask 077
root=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai
p="$root/.worktrees/independent-chat-20261128"
sha=231a8f47dc9cb566080ba9e69f758ed47885f073
base=sha256:e5802feac280f275c9591757bd76a0b215e711e6a534cd9d3dcdf579fddfb822
tag=debug-ai-debug-ai:latest
candidate=debug-ai-debug-ai:teaching-231a8f47
backup=debug-ai-debug-ai:rollback-before-teaching-231a8f47
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")" = "$base"
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$tag")" = "$base"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD)" = 693aa63b750fa54402c5e321af911778cc096baa
git -C "$p" diff --quiet HEAD -- compose.yaml
for x in 'server/chat/index.html cd7f70c' 'server/chat/index.js 2e11c7a' 'server/chat/ui.js 6cf85e6' 'server/main.js 4d94564'; do
 read -r f h <<<"$x"; [[ "$(git -C "$p" hash-object "$f")" == "$h"* ]] || { echo COMPOSER_CHANGED_SINCE_READ;exit 52; }
done
test ! -e "$p/server/command-module/teaching.js"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p="/app/runtime";for(const d of ["chat","durable/run-state-v2"]){const q=p+"/"+d;if(!fs.existsSync(q))continue;for(const n of fs.readdirSync(q).filter(n=>n.endsWith(".json"))){const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(q+"/"+n));if(x.turns?.some(t=>t.state==="running")||["RUNNING","QUEUED","RETRY_WAIT","PAUSED"].includes(x.job_status)){console.log("ACTIVE_OR_PAUSED_RUN");process.exit(53)}}}'
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
files="server/chat/index.html server/chat/index.js server/chat/ui.js server/main.js compose.yaml"
mkdir "$tmp/old" "$tmp/new"
for f in $files; do mkdir -p "$tmp/old/$(dirname "$f")";cp -p "$p/$f" "$tmp/old/$f";done
cp -p "$root/.env" "$tmp/old/env"
git -C "$p" archive "$sha" $files server/command-module/teaching.js | tar -x -C "$tmp/new"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_MODEL_GATES);if(!x.qwen35||x.deepseek)process.exit(2);x.deepseek={origin:"http://127.0.0.1:18186",model_id:"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017",max_output_tokens:1024,runtime_context_tokens:8192};console.log(JSON.stringify(x))' > "$tmp/gates"
compose(){ docker compose -p debug-ai -f "$p/compose.yaml" --env-file "$root/.env" --project-directory "$p" "$@"; }
docker image tag "$base" "$backup"
rollback(){ rc=$?;trap - ERR;set +e;for f in $files;do cp -p "$tmp/old/$f" "$p/$f";done;rm -f "$p/server/command-module/teaching.js";cp -p "$tmp/old/env" "$root/.env";docker image tag "$backup" "$tag";compose up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate debug-ai;rr=$?;echo "TEACHING_ROLLBACK=$rr";if test "$rr" = 0;then rm -rf "$tmp";fi;exit "$rc"; }
trap rollback ERR
for f in $files server/command-module/teaching.js;do cp "$tmp/new/$f" "$p/$f";done
python3 - "$root/.env" "$tmp/gates" <<'PY'
import sys,pathlib,re,json,os
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);s=p.read_text();g=json.dumps(json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text()),separators=(',',':'))
for k,v in [('DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_MODEL_GATES',"'"+g+"'"),('DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION','true')]:
 pat=r'(?m)^'+k+r'=.*$'
 assert len(re.findall(pat,s))<=1
 s=re.sub(pat,lambda m:k+'='+v,s) if re.search(pat,s) else s.rstrip()+'\n'+k+'='+v+'\n'
p.write_text(s)
PY
compose config -q
docker image tag "$candidate" "$tag"
compose up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate debug-ai
ready=NO
for i in $(seq 1 12);do if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health >/dev/null && test "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:18788/chat)" = 401;then ready=YES;break;fi;sleep 2;done
test "$ready" = YES
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$candidate")"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const x=JSON.parse(process.env.DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_MODEL_GATES);if(!x.qwen35||!x.deepseek||process.env.DEBUG_AI_COMMAND_EXTERNAL_QUALIFICATION!=="true")process.exit(1);console.log("TEACHING_MODE_CONFIGURED")'
trap - ERR
rm -rf "$tmp"
echo LIVE_CHAT_TEACHING_DEPLOYMENT_PASS
